text:
tara: quick async check — onboarding orca-70b for hosted serving. a few items I need eyes on: weights location, tokenizer quirks (esp. BOS/SEP handling), and quant path decision (awq vs gptq vs fp8). pinging @josh @matt @li

josh: saw this. where are the final weights? last artifact I saw was in /s3/models/orca-70b/release-cand/ but there was also a staging copy. which one should infra use for canary?

tara: canonical path is s3://redwood-models/orca-70b/v1.2/weights.tar (not the release-cand). staging copy has an extra tok fix we didn't merge. I've uploaded the tokenizer fix in the PR below.

li: re tokenizer quirks — the model expects BOS token 1 but our tokenizer emits 0 for empty prefix in the current bundle. PR adjusts tokenizer config to set bos_token_id=1 and adds a small detokenize patch for trailing spaces. lightweight, but please smoke test.

matt: thanks. quick note on quant: we ran both gptq and awq passes. gptq gives slightly better ppl on the calibration set (~1.8% lower), awq gives much faster decode and 30% lower memory. fp8 run had instability on some attention blocks (noticed NaNs on long context).

josh: do we have the calib dataset and eval prompts handy? need to know size and prompt distribution to approve AWQ tradeoffs.

tara: calib data is in s3://redwood-calib/orca-70b/calib-v2 — ~12k sequences, mixed doc/qa/longform, avg length ~512 tokens. eval set is ~1k curated prompts (gradients of length). seed used: 42.

li: important: for AWQ we used a smaller calibration subset (2k sequences) tuned for latency points. that explains the small gaps in ppl vs gptq. AWQ seems to undercalibrate rare token logits; you can see top-10 token probs skew slightly.

matt: can you paste the comparison snippet? small table or sample logs would help signoff.

li: sure — sample from eval run:
```
Model     ppl   lat(ms/token)  mem(GB)  spike_naNs
FP32      11.23  25            32       0
GPTQ      11.45  28            18       0
AWQ       11.66  19            12       0
FP8       12.50  18            10       2 (rare)
```
(above: avg ppl on eval set, lat measured on p4d-like hardware, mem is per-replica)

josh: ok that clarifies. AWQ trades ~0.4 ppl for big resource wins; FP8 has NaN risks so not acceptable for hosted yet.

tara: proposal: default serving config uses AWQ quant with kv-cache enabled, and model catalog entry includes a GPTQ fallback for higher-quality routes (tiered routing). need product/infra approval.

matt: +1 for that routing. we should also include an automatic accuracy regression alert (example prompt set) — if ppl > 0.6 from baseline, roll back to GPTQ automatically.

li: agree. also add a quick preflight that checks tokenizer mapping (BOS/SEP) against model config before allowing canary. last time mismatch caused off-by-one tokenization for code prompts.

josh: I'll add a gating check in the deployment pipeline: 1) verify s3 checksum of weights path, 2) run tokenizer unit smoke (3 tokens cases), 3) run 50-sample eval against baseline prompts. if any fail, block canary.

ops-bot: deploy-checklist created: checklist/2122223333-orca70b-serve.json (presubmit hooks: checksum, tokenizer-smoke, 50-eval).

tara: thanks @ops-bot. next: PR for tokenizer + quant config is https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/1789 — needs 2 approvals. @matt @josh can you review the tokenizer and the model-catalog meta?

matt: on it, will review tonight. :eyes:

josh: aim to get final signoff by EOD tomorrow. quick question — calibration seeds: should we standardize to the same 2k subset for AWQ across models to make alerts comparable?

li: yes — recommend standard AWQ subset for latency-focused calibrations (we keep full 12k for final accuracy eval). that'll make regression thresholds predictable.

tara: final ask: can product confirm that 0.4 ppl delta is acceptable on hosted default? If not, we'll flip default to GPTQ and AWQ for burst-capacity only. @product (cc @mike)

matt: tagging product separately, but my read: most applications prefer lower latency/cost, but any semantic-sensitive features should pin to GPTQ. we need per-route overrides in catalog UI.

li: last operational note — tokenizer bundle in the PR includes a tiny migration: set tokenizers.json version to 3 and add mapping table. migration script included, but infra needs to run `tokenizer-migrate --src s3://... --dst s3://...` during canary swap.

josh: ack. I'll add migration to the deploy-checklist as step 2.5.

tara: thanks all. if no objections, I'll move AWQ default into the model catalog tomorrow afternoon and kick the canary after the PR approvals. :thumbsup:

matt: no objections from eng-ml side.

li: no objections.

josh: go for it after PR approvals.

ops-bot: canary started at 2122224120 for orca-70b on p4de-servepool-canary-3. monitoring hooks active.

tara: noted — will watch alerts and the regression dashboard. thanks everyone! :party_parrot:
